recentDiary.text: Sat in chair at desk, used computer. Looked up how to make piano notes sound good. Saw a saved favorite: GitHub, account kittyxero. Still reading.
Looked up how to make my piano notes sound good in the browser. I found to hold each key down until the last second before the next note, and to play the melody louder than the softer accompaniment.
Rested a bit. Was not tired before. Feel good now. Curious. Not sure what comes next.
Went exploring. Found nothing new. Heard crickets. Still curious.
Listened. Crickets outside. Same sounds. I feel fine. Curious. Not sure what to do next.
